note: The rows of Star (Mantra), in the default order. kind "app": a Swift .app, opened and quit directly by the star. kind "lua": still a Hammerspoon app, toggled through hs (STAR.toggleKey). Converting an app to Swift changes only its row here: kind "app" and "app" = its path in /Applications. build.sh installs this file as ~/.config/star-rows.json.

rows.name: Swift Matrix (Mantra) (what runs now and what starts with the Mac: quit it, or switch its auto-start)
rows.about: A simple task manager: every app running and everything that starts at login, each with QUIT and AUTO-START

rows.name: Automated Mouse Actions
rows.about: When a pop-up appears, puts the pointer on its default button

rows.name: Enter sends in Claude
rows.about: A plain Return sends the message in a claude.ai tab; Shift+Return makes a new line

rows.name: Buckets
rows.about: The Hammerspoon keyboard: clipboard dispenser, F keys, hand and deck

rows.name: Sister App (Mantra) (MANTRA CHAT on and off, and its page)
rows.about: MANTRA CHAT: the page that mirrors this session and reads it aloud

rows.name: Download Monitor
rows.about: Every download on this Mac, each with its own bar

rows.name: Network Aggregate Connection Keeper (two lines at once: Wi-Fi + phone; Connection Keeper, aggregate)
rows.about: Joins the Wi-Fi and the phone on USB into one internet (mantra_networkaggregate); ONE CONNECTION switches it off

rows.name: Star API (one API for every Star app: open, read, press, quit; port 8863)
rows.about: Keeps the common Star API running for the phone and cloud sessions (STAR_API); ON / OFF in its window

rows.name: DaVinci Resolve Actions
rows.about: Everything for Resolve in one app: pages on ⌥`, HD/UHD, the import button, one-button actions

rows.name: DaVinci Grading Tutorial (balance, grade and export, taught by voice)
rows.about: The one-button grading workflow taught by voice, diagrams and pictures: balance, curves, Film Look Creator, export for Svemir; offline

rows.name: E16 for DaVinci Resolve (Resolve hotkeys from your keyboard profile, mixer, playhead)
rows.about: Columns 1 to 4 of the E16: SOLO, MUTE, VOLUME, PAN; rows: four audio tracks, their names on the screen; Shift twice turns the pages (A5–A8 and on). Only one E16 app at a time.

rows.name: Voice cloning (clone, choose, test every voice)
rows.about: Clone a voice, choose which one talks, and test every voice you have

rows.name: Find a File (terminal or Spotlight)
rows.about: One folder, a name or words: the terminal find or the Spotlight index, live; settings show what Spotlight knows

rows.name: Dock Switcher (⌃` over everything on the Dock, running or not)
rows.about: Control-backtick switches between everything on the Dock, running or not

rows.name: App Store
rows.about: Search for an app, fetch the developer's own .dmg, install it

rows.name: Apple Door
rows.about: Opens Apple's update servers for thirty minutes, then shuts them again

rows.name: Freedom
rows.about: Every Apple service and server, step by step: check, free, undo

rows.name: E16 Ableton Live Actions (A1, MIDI to MK Control, MIDI to Key Stroke)
rows.about: Everything for Live in one app: A1, MIDI to MK Control, MIDI to Key Stroke (reads MIDI: in the E16 group, one MIDI app at a time)

rows.name: E16 Ableton Remote (the E16 as Live's remote: fixed numbers, pages, profiles)
rows.about: The OXI E16 in Remote Mode drives Live: knob n sends CC n and note n over 112 pages, its own screen, Shift twice picks a page, profiles placed on pages, a Claude chat per knob

rows.name: Ableton Assistant A1 (Space continues; 1 and 2 zoom; h splits; 7, 8 and 9 are the markers (back, set or delete, on); the arrows walk the transients and ⌘ with them walks the tracks; I and O jump to the next transient and mark the loop's in and out on its waveform's zero, L turns the loop on; the markers on the page, two ticked are the loop; the last set opens where you stopped; the time blob is the clock of the insert point; every override has its tick on the page)
rows.about: Ableton fitted to your hands: the keys, the markers, the loop and the clock blob

rows.name: KeyringTester (open any file of keys, or every file in ~/Downloads/API; Google keys API by API)
rows.about: Opens any file of keys and tests each with the cheapest read call; Google keys API by API

rows.name: Installation Logger
rows.about: Records every file an installer writes, so it can all be taken out again

rows.name: Opening and Closing (Chrome in the chosen profiles; closes Speechify's Home window and the Login Item Added banner)
rows.about: Opening: Chrome starts in the ticked profiles. Closing: Speechify's Home window at launch, the Login Item Added banner after 3 s

rows.name: Star Monitor (every app: start, stop, reorder, what comes back, time run)
rows.about: The page that runs the star: start, stop, reorder, and how long each app has run

rows.name: Voice Engine (Mantra) (the voice of the Mac: on and off, which voice, subtitles)
rows.about: One app since 1.11.2026 (Claude to Marko Voice + Voice of Claude): the engine on or off with its three parts, which voice speaks, how the subtitles look

rows.name: Voice to Text (Mantra) (talk, and it types: Whisper Turbo, Claude; your own and the public one, v3)
rows.about: F1: talk, F1 again: what you said is cleaned in your style and typed where the cursor is; the speakers go to 6 % while it listens

rows.name: Spectral Analyzer (Mantra) (the sound seen: FLUX's meters, clicks found)
rows.about: Any sound passed through and measured like FLUX:: Analyzer; the voice's clips checked for clicks

rows.name: Sound Recorder (Mantra) (record, play, see the waveform; the take is gone when it quits)
rows.about: Input and output with their volume and VU meters in SoundSource's look; record, play, the waveform; nothing kept after QUIT

rows.name: MIDI to MK Control (a knob becomes a Mackie Control command: the playback position under a knob, which Live's own MIDI mapping will not give)
rows.about: A knob on a MIDI controller becomes a Mackie Control command in Live

rows.name: MIDI to Key Stroke (a knob's CC or a key's note becomes a key, or the system volume)
rows.about: A knob's CC or a key's note becomes a key stroke, or the Mac's own volume

rows.name: G815 Lights (every key of the Logitech G815 its own still colour)
rows.about: Every key of the G815 its own still colour and brightness, three banks M1 M2 M3, painted at every start

rows.name: Keyboard Monitor (Mantra) (every key you press on one big blob like the volume blob)
rows.about: One big glass blob like the volume blob, centred low on the screen: the key just pressed until the next one; ✕ quits

rows.name: Webcam Recorder (Mantra) (any camera and sound input, recorded H.265 with time code)
rows.about: Any camera and sound input; the VU on the left edge; ● records ~/Movies/mb_….mov H.265 1080p with the real-time time code; ⌘F full screen, Escape back

rows.name: Star Menu (alt+space, search and open)
rows.about: This box: alt+space searches the Mac's applications and the rows of this menu

rows.name: djay Sync (Mantra) (djay Pro's playlists <-> DJ Mantra on the phone, over adb)
rows.about: Both sides in one window, each playlist SAME / NEW / CHANGED; SYNC Mac -> phone, PULL phone -> djay; can sync by itself when the phone appears

rows.name: DJ Transfer Monitor (Mantra) (what is copying to the phone: from which Mac folder into which phone folder, how fast)
rows.about: Live view of djay-sync / adb push: playlist, file, FROM -> TO, file and total bars, MB/s, ETA, files done and skipped

rows.name: Screenshot to TIDAL (Mantra) (screenshots of a chart or tracklist -> a playlist on your TIDAL)
rows.about: Reads the newest 3 Desktop screenshots on the Mac (Vision), artist / title rows, finds each on TIDAL with a confidence, CREATE PLAYLIST on his account

rows.name: Yshai Afterman Percussion School (Mantra) (which lessons are missing; DOWNLOAD MISSING into ~/Movies/Yhshai AfterMan)
rows.about: Checks every lesson of the course against LESSON<N>: Complete / Missing / partial, DOWNLOAD MISSING or per lesson, never the same file twice (videos by duration); videos through Video DownloadHelper's ffmpeg, Notation PDFs

rows.name: Timer Stopwatch Clock (S stopwatch, T timer, R the time of day; enormous digits)
rows.about: A stopwatch, a timer and a clock in one black window, read across a room

rows.name: Elevate Media Project Monitor (Mantra) (every project's stage from Drive, ▶ FINISH after the client's approval; Kie and Higgsfield credits; uploads)
rows.about: The credits of every service Elevate Media uses, what they buy, green / amber / red against the work left, top-up alerts, statistics and CSV export

rows.name: CQ MixPad Tutorial
rows.about: The CQ-12T taught by voice, diagrams and the hand with a ring in CQ MixPad and Live; the Santoshi concert as the case study; offline

rows.name: Virtual Cam (the phone is your webcam: open it, then choose "OBS Virtual Camera" in Zoom)
rows.about: Connects to the phone on the USB cable; its picture is the Mac webcam; its whole camera screen is in the window, mouse and keyboard

rows.name: OBS Studio (only for mixing scenes; add the window "Virtual Cam (Mantra) — clean" as a Window Capture)
rows.about: Open it only when you want to mix. While it runs, OBS Virtual Camera sends the OBS mix; when it closes, Virtual Cam (Mantra) is the webcam again

rows.name: Darken the Screens (Mantra) (⌃⌥⌘F1: every screen black, again: light)
rows.about: ⌃⌥⌘F1 darkens every screen to complete darkness; ⌃⌥⌘F1 again brings full light

rows.name: Code Filler (the security code from the Nothing phone's SMS, filled where the cursor is)
rows.about: Watches the Nothing phone's SMS and notifications over USB; a new verification code goes into the focused text box, else the clipboard

rows.name: Answer Claude (Mantra) (answer Claude's questions with one click)
rows.about: Claude's questions and permission prompts answered from one small window

rows.name: Controller Mapper (Mantra) (his controllers mapped to keys and actions)
rows.about: Buttons and knobs of his MIDI and game controllers mapped to keys and actions

rows.name: Free Voice Convert Equalizer (Mantra) (a voice into another voice, studio profile)
rows.about: Seed-VC voice conversion, same length frame by frame, studio-profile EQ, -16 LUFS

rows.name: Import Button (Mantra) (one button to import into the app in front)
rows.about: One floating button that imports files into the app in front

rows.name: MIDI Tools (Mantra) (MIDI to MK Control, MIDI to Key Stroke)
rows.about: MIDI notes and CCs turned into MK Control actions and key strokes

rows.name: Macro Recorder (Mantra) (record clicks and keys, play them back relative to the window)
rows.about: Records mouse and keyboard, plays back relative to the window; RECALIBRATE

rows.name: Resolve Pages (Mantra) (DaVinci Resolve's pages by one click)
rows.about: Switches DaVinci Resolve's pages from a small window

rows.name: Stem Separation (Mantra) (a song into vocals, drums, bass and other)
rows.about: Splits a song into stems on this Mac

rows.name: Stream Deck Control (Mantra) (the apps on the Stream Deck's keys)
rows.about: Puts the running apps on the Stream Deck's keys; a pressed app moves to the first key

rows.name: UHD HD Display (Mantra) (the screen between UHD and HD)
rows.about: Switches a display between UHD and HD resolution

rows.name: Chromium Virtual Machine (Mantra)
rows.about: The Chrome computer in Oracle Cloud: its screen in a window, clipboard shared both ways, files dropped on it go to the VM

rows.name: VM Router (Mantra)
rows.about: One door to the Chrome VM for many sessions at once: each session its own tab, account and folder, clipboard and keys one at a time, Gemini paced per account

rows.name: NDI Mantra Monitor (an NDI video feed watched on the Mac)
rows.about: Shows an NDI video source on the Mac

rows.name: MKV Converter (MPA) (classroom recordings → MOV for DaVinci Resolve)
rows.about: Watches a folder (Downloads) for MPA recordings and converts them to MOV with time code for Resolve

rows.name: Indian Mantras (Gayatri and Asato Ma, word by word, by a warm Indian voice)
rows.about: The Gayatri Mantra and Asato Ma taught word by word: Devanagari, transliteration and meaning, the MA Reader Web highlight, SPEED down to 0.5, a VOICE switcher (Hume, Google Gemini, Speechify); offline
